mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% MoM is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% is not followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS levels and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (UNRATE rises & PAYEMS falls) is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS changes on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (HOUST declines & UNRATE rises) is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5%) signals strong economic fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (INDPRO rises & UNRATE < 5%) is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and UNRATE conditions on 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
